remarks: Step into your dream home with this stunning fully renovated one-bedroom and one-bathroom apartment. With a spacious living room and kitchen, this unit has been meticulously designed with modern finishes and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator, electric stove with oven, microwave, and dishwasher. The quartz countertops and soft-close kitchen cabinets are both sleek and functional, while the modern recess lighting and luxurious laminate flooring throughout the unit create an ambiance of pure elegance. The tiled bathroom features a tub/shower with glass sliding doors, and natural light pours in through the abundance of windows, allowing you to bask in the beauty of your surroundings. The personal intercom with a screen, camera, microphone, and striker ensures your safety, while the building's camera security system and fire alarm system provide added peace of mind. Stay connected with cable and fiber optic readiness for high-speed streaming, TV watching, and web surfing. You'll also have immediate hot water with your own in-unit hot water heater. Laundry facilities are conveniently located in the common area, and extra storage is available for rent. This pet-friendly apartment is located within walking distance to restaurants, cafes, bars, clubs, and the SoNo Mall, and major highways, transportation, and shopping centers are just a stone's throw away. With parking available on site for an additional fee.
